title: Truvizy Threat Intelligence (TAXII)
descriptionMarkdown: The Truvizy Threat Intelligence connector brings scam and phishing indicators confirmed by the Truvizy detection network into Microsoft Sentinel through the built-in TAXII 2.1 data connector. Indicators are curated for safe blocking: only high-confidence indicators are published, shared platforms (such as youtube.com) are never listed at the domain level, and indicators expire automatically when they stop being relevant. To request feed credentials, contact [Truvizy](https://truvizy.app).

sampleQueries.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where SourceSystem == "Truvizy"
| where ExpirationDateTime > now() and Active == true
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| project TimeGenerated, ThreatType, Url, DomainName, ConfidenceScore, ExpirationDateTime

ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where SourceSystem == "Truvizy"
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

sampleQueries.description: Truvizy domain indicators matched against DNS queries
sampleQueries.query:
let ioc_lookBack = 14d;
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(ioc_lookBack) and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem == "Truvizy" and isnotempty(DomainName)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| join kind=innerunique (DnsEvents | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)) on $left.DomainName == $right.Name
| project TimeGenerated, DomainName, ClientIP, ConfidenceScore

dataTypes.name: ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator | where SourceSystem == "Truvizy"
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Truvizy feed credentials
customs.description: A Truvizy TAXII username and password, issued by the Truvizy team during onboarding. Contact https://truvizy.app to request access.

instructionSteps.title: Connect Microsoft Sentinel to the Truvizy TAXII 2.1 feed
instructionSteps.description:
Configure the built-in TAXII connector with the Truvizy server details below, then select Add.

1. **Friendly name (for server):** Truvizy
2. **API root URL:** https://taxii.truvizy.app/functions/v1/taxii-server/api/
3. **Collection ID:** b7c1d2e0-5a4f-4c8e-9d3a-2f6b8c1e7a90
4. **Username / Password:** issued by the Truvizy team during onboarding
5. **Import indicators:** At most one hour (recommended polling frequency: once per hour)

Use the friendly name **Truvizy** exactly: the analytics rules and sample queries in this solution filter on it.
